description: This file defines API routes for bug management in a FastAPI application, including endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting bugs, and fetching bug statistics. It imports models, services, and dependencies related to bugs and users, and uses FastAPI's APIRouter to register various bug-related routes.

methods.name: create_bug( bug_data: BugCreate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new bug report, accepting bug data and current user as dependencies.

methods.name: get_bugs( project_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by project ID"), assigned_to: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by assigned user ID"), current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a list of bugs, optionally filtered by project ID and assigned user.

methods.name: get_bug_statistics(current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch bug statistics for dashboard display.

methods.name: get_bug( bug_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a specific bug by its ID, raising a 404 error if not found.

methods.name: update_bug( bug_id: str, bug_data: BugUpdate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing bug's details.

methods.name: delete_bug( bug_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a bug by its ID, raising a 404 error if not found.
